title: Property Management & Repairs | Rosa's Sparkling Cleaning
metaDescription: Recurring visits, minor repairs and maintenance oversight for vacant or listed properties in Ocala, Tampa and Spring Hill, FL — one point of contact instead of five.
h1: Someone should be checking on it. Let it be us.
intro: A vacant or listed property needs eyes on it — a loose cabinet door, a leak, a package left on the porch. We do recurring walkthroughs and handle the small repairs ourselves instead of just emailing you a list.
heroImageAlt: A handyman installing a kitchen cabinet drawer with a power drill
whatsappMessage: Hi, I'd like to ask about your property management service

sections.heading: What's included
items: Scheduled walkthroughs on the cadence you choose
A photo report after every visit

sections.heading: Who it's for
sections.body: Out-of-town owners, agents managing a vacant listing, and anyone who'd rather get a photo report than a surprise phone call.

evidence.heading: See the difference
evidence.alt: Before and after comparison of a kitchen: cabinet doors hanging open and damaged on the left, cabinets repaired and closed with the counter cleared on the right
evidence.caption: Same kitchen, caught early — nothing left to surprise a buyer's inspector.
